create_toxicity_filter: create a ToxicityFilter instance with source and target language toxicity word lists and thresholds
filter_line_by_max_toxicity: filter a dataset line by checking if source or target toxicity count exceeds the max_toxicity threshold
filter_line_by_toxicity_difference: filter a dataset line by checking if the toxicity difference between source and target exceeds the max_toxicity_difference threshold
load_toxicity_word_lists: load source and target toxicity word lists from file paths using a template and optional English pornography list
review_toxicity_filter_class: review the ToxicityFilter class that extends Filter to remove toxic lines from translation datasets based on configurable thresholds
